title: directSttSessionAttribution.v1
description: Post-session diarization attribution event (#3746 AI-D3, design docs/faz-24-scheduled-diarization-design-3746.md D5). Metadata only: per-window speaker assignments and acoustic times — never audio, never transcript text, never UTF-16 offsets. The producer (live-stt batch worker) knows window TIME ranges but not window text, so it emits one dominant-or-UU assignment per window; the consumer (transcript-service, BE-D4) derives the SpeakerAttribution v2 turn — textStart=0, textEnd=len(text_draft) — from the stored window text it owns, then validates via SpeakerAttribution.parse against that window's own text and duration. Breaking changes require a version bump + consumer sign-off.

modelRevision.description: The resolved model revision actually backing this run (ADR-0033 pin rule; never a floating name in staging/production).

audioSampleCount.description: PCM16 mono 16 kHz samples the batch actually processed; the finish handshake cross-checks this against the gateway's expected total.

windows.description: One entry per source window that received a dominance decision. Windows the session-batch could not attribute confidently carry speaker=UU; windows may be absent entirely when the batch cancelled (then no event is published at all).

speaker.description: Session-stable anonymous label from the single whole-session clustering pass, or UU when no speaker dominates the window.

startMs.description: Window start inside the session audio timeline.

dominanceRatio.description: Fraction of the window's speech time held by the emitted speaker (UU rows carry the best ratio that still failed the threshold). Threshold is producer config, not contract.
